title: Three coexisting solenoids with inseparable triple links
description: Cases 30300001 and 30300007 each contain three chaotic solenoids. Removing any one leaves the other two separated by a sphere. Their triple cannot be separated by a sphere. The two compact triples are inequivalent under ambient homeomorphisms.
coordinates: Native Cartesian positions at equal axis scales. Each panel combines 40,000 states from each of three attracting tubes.
